description: Start from a starter game (see list_starters): makes a NEW game in this studio (or, with `game`, reuses one of yours) and returns a link to the starter's source as a ZIP, valid for 5 minutes, plus the steps to unpack it, rewire it to the new game's publishable key, and publish it. Premium starters need a paid plan; a locked one returns the upgrade link instead, and nothing is created.

game.description: Reuse one of your games instead of making a new one (its pk_ or exact name): e.g. to fetch a fresh link after one expired.

label.description: A name for the new game. Defaults to the starter's title.

starter.description: The starter's slug, from list_starters, e.g. 'slither-arena'.

name: remix_game
title: Start a new game from a starter
